people.name: Maya Okafor
people.about: Did the FDE switch two years ago; candid about what the role is day to day.

interactions.title: Intro chat
interactions.summary: Walked through her path from backend to FDE. Says the interviews lean on debugging a customer's broken pipeline live.

interactions.title: Resume review
interactions.summary: Went over the resume line by line. Cut the coursework section, lead with the agent work.

interactions.title: Mock interview
interactions.summary: 45 minute mock. Strong on the system walkthrough, rushed the customer questions at the start.
interactions.transcript:
Maya: Okay, pretend I'm the customer. Our nightly job is failing and nobody knows why.
Me: Before I touch anything, when did it last succeed, and what changed since then?
Maya: Good. Keep going.

people.name: Devin Park
people.about: Runs the inference platform team; hires juniors who ship side projects.

interactions.title: Met at the meetup
interactions.summary: Talked about batching and KV cache costs.

interactions.title: LinkedIn follow-up
interactions.summary: Sent a portfolio link; he replied with two papers to read.

interactions.title: Team overview
interactions.summary: Explained how his team is split. Open to a referral when a role opens.
